item.title: Verbose beta 236
item.description:
Brain dump, Audio only, and Plan my day

Mac

  • Record as adds Brain dump and Audio only, after Thought. Brain dump records you talking through your day. Audio only keeps the sound with no transcript, for a melody, a guitar part, or a room.
  • Audio only records at your microphone's full quality, with voice processing off. It saves 24-bit sound at 48 or 44.1 kHz, so music keeps its high end and dynamics. Its Library row plays without opening it.
  • Transcribe an Audio only recording later, as a voice note or any kind. Its title, notes, moments, and audio stay. Touch and hold Transcribe on iPhone, or open its menu on the Mac, to pick a kind.
  • Plan my day sorts a brain dump into Top three, Today, Tomorrow, This week, and Someday. It uses only the days you said, counted from when you recorded, keeps ideas apart, and links each task to the moment you said it.
  • Send a plan's tasks to the Reminders list you pick. A task gets a due date only when you said a day, ideas go in only if you check them, and sending again adds only what's new.
  • Organize today's thoughts into the same plan, linked to each thought. On iPhone it's on the Thoughts page. On the Mac, it's Organize on today's page.
  • Change any recording's kind later, including to Brain dump or Audio only. Changing a kind never deletes the transcript, notes, or results. Changing one to Brain dump offers to run Plan my day.
  • Choose File › New Brain Dump to talk or type through your day, then make a plan. Hold your dictation keys to talk into the note; those dictations stay in the note, not in Dictations. The menu bar and an optional Home tile open it too.
